source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U28: Distinguish offence-specific punishment,fine factors and special-court procedure

payload.title: A punishment range belongs to a particular offence
payload.core_explanation_md:
The source gives different imprisonment ranges and fine consequences for different offences. For example, the described section 7 and abetment routes use three-to-seven-year ranges, while criminal misconduct has its own four-to-ten-year range. Do not use a single maximum for all conduct or confuse an attempt with the completed offence. Fine determination considers the described obtained-property/value or unexplained-resource factors under the applicable provision.

Special Judges try the specified offences. The source describes a two-year trial endeavour, reasoned extensions in six-month periods and an ordinary aggregate four-year formulation. This is not a promise that every case automatically terminates at an absolute stopwatch deadline. The special forum and lawful transfer/appellate rules must be distinguished; the fact a forum is special does not mean no transfer can ever occur.

self_check.prompt_text: Is the described trial-duration formulation an automatic acquittal rule?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Do not replace its qualified language with an absolute outcome.

payload.stem_md: A revision sheet assigns the same imprisonment range to bribery, misconduct and every attempt. What is the correct method?

options.explanation_md: That does not identify the applicable provision.

options.text_md: Treat a fine as the only possible consequence in all cases
Match each alleged offence and version to its own punishment provision
options.explanation_md: Different routes have different ranges and conditions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Different routes have different ranges and conditions.

payload.stem_md: A note says a pending trial automatically ends after two years without considering the statutory extension formulation. What must be corrected?

options.text_md: The endeavour and reasoned-extension language must be preserved
Every case must instead last exactly ten years
Only the bank may choose the trial end
